page.title: My company legal entities
page.subtitle: Declare here only the legal entities of YOUR company that can carry and invoice an assignment.
page.why: An established firm is rarely a single company: a consulting entity, a contracting one, sometimes a subsidiary per country. The team, the talent pool and the pipeline stay shared; what changes is who invoices.
page.subscriptionNote: Your {{brand}} subscription does not change: one contract and one seat count for the whole workspace.
page.heading: Your company legal entities, {{name}}
page.notHere: Your clients, partners and competitors are not configured here.
page.askLaura: What is a carrying legal entity for?

empty.title: No company declared
empty.description: Your missions therefore carry no legal name, which is the normal case for a single-company firm. Declare them only if several of your entities invoice.

readOnly: Declaring a company is a billing decision: ask whoever handles billing for your workspace.

form.name: Legal name
form.namePlaceholder: As it will appear on an invoice
form.registrationHint: Optional: not every jurisdiction uses the same one.
form.countryHint: Two letters, the billing country code.

archiveNote: We archive, we never delete: a company has carried real missions and invoiced months, and erasing it would make the history that names it unreadable. Archived, it leaves the pickers, not the record.
